messages.label: check: in recovery, paused, at rp 'N'
check: same reached point on every node
gp_configuration_history := one 'DR promoted at rp N' row

cards.title: Why this exact order
items: Segments before the coordinator, so its FTS finds live primaries when it starts probing
Promote before resume: the startup process sleeps in recoveryPausesHere(); pg_promote only arms the trigger
On wake it ends recovery right after the restore-point record it stands on — the cut is exactly rp 'N'
The cut lands at the point replay reached, not at the one being served

cards.title: No restart, nothing to unset
items: DR behavior is keyed on IsDRReplicaMode() = hot_standby AND in recovery — it lifts when recovery ends
The frozen slots stay populated but unread; stat views guard DR columns behind pg_is_in_recovery()
standby.signal stays in place; no GUC to unset, no restart

cards.title: Deliberate non-waits
items: pg_promote(false) is async — a standby QD cannot poll promoted QEs; pg_promote(true) would deadlock
gg_dr_promote() is the SQL twin; the history rewrite is ggdr's extra step (DELETE, not TRUNCATE)
Irreversible: recovery only moves forward; mirrors and standby come later via gprecoverseg / gpinitstandby
